model.selection: inherited session model for every arm

scope: bounded deterministic synthetic modeling pilot; not native SIMLOX validation; no training

arms.A: schema + tasks; single submission, no execution feedback
arms.B: schema + tasks + mechanism cards; single submission, no execution feedback
arms.C: schema + tasks + mechanism cards + up to two execution-feedback revision rounds; no final grader access

common_budget.tools_policy: A/B read only their supplied public files and write own submissions; C may additionally call runner validate; no evaluator/private/source browsing
common_budget.wall_budget_enforcement: controller records elapsed; overruns flagged, not silently claimed enforced
common_budget.repair_rounds: C initial candidate plus at most two revisions per executable task; A/B one candidate

limitations: One context per arm, one sample per task; within-arm carryover possible
Shared filesystem with instruction-based isolation, not security-enforced blinded execution
Exact model snapshot, sampling seed, token usage and metered cost unavailable
C treatment includes extra tool/repair opportunity; timing not pure inference latency
Final grading is never fed back; clarification followup is separate from primary scores

scoring.model_tasks: T01-T06 structural requirement checks + independently hand-derived trace assertions
scoring.clarification_task: T07 first-response question correctness; not counted as executable-model success
scoring.unsupported_task: T08 correct capability refusal; not counted as executable-model success
scoring.secondary_demonstrations: T07 answered by preregistered simulated user oracle capacity=2; retain T07 response but relabel a copy to T01 for the identical fully specified structural/behavioral contract; separate from primary scores.
scoring.feedback: C sees compiler/runtime diagnostics and trace only; final evaluator/oracles never exposed
